note: Game tables of Asteroids rev 4 in the ROM set (sources/docs/disasm_notes.md; VEC:/MAC: labels of the Atari sources, dis $addr = McFadden's rev 4 listing verified against the ROM). The ROM files and load addresses are those of rom2vectors.spec.json.

sin.note: VEC:SINCOS (dis ThrustTbl): 127 * sin(n/256 * 2 pi) for n = 0..64, the first quadrant; the thrust and the shots take cos/sin of the 8-bit angle from it (notes 2.4, 4.2)

rockPoints.note: MAC:SPLIT 99$ (dis AstPointsTbl): BCD points x 10 for the small / medium / large rock = 100 / 50 / 20 (notes 5.3)

saucerYSpeed.note: MAC:EFIRE 99$ (dis ScrYSpeedTbl): the saucer's Y velocity every 128 frames, by RAND & 3 (notes 6.2)

shotAngle.note: MAC:ATANA (dis ShotAngleTbl): arctan of a 4-bit ratio in 8-bit angle units, $20 = 45 degrees (notes 6.2)

textPositions.note: MSG:VGMSGS (dis TextPosTbl): 11 x (X/4, Y/4) of the messages 0..10 — the lower left of the first glyph (notes 9.3)

pieceDirections.note: VEC:EXPDIR: 6 x (dx, dy) of the pieces of the exploding ship — the starting offset /16 and the velocity /256 a frame (notes 8)

messageOffsets.note: VEC:L0 (dis EnglishTextTbl): the offsets of the 11 English messages from L0, packed 3 characters in 2 bytes (ASCIN)

messagesPacked.note: the packed messages 0..10: AAAAABBB BBCCCCCD — 5-bit codes 0 = end, 1 = blank, 2..4 = '0'..'2', 5..30 = A..Z, D = end of string
